newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Tamro 1996 profit seen up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Tamro 1996 profit seen up.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 216 million markka median forecast for pharmaceuticals wholesaler Oy Tamro Ab's full-year 1996 profit before extraordinary items and tax.
(Profit forecast by 12 analysts, EPS by 10 analysts). @
Tamro's results are due on February 21 at 0900/0700 GMT.
In 1995, Tamro had a 155 million markka proforma profit before extraordinary items and tax.
For the company's full-year 1997 profit, nine of the 12 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 244 million markka (mean 238 million) in a 201-277 million markka range.

Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Carnegie Securities, Enskilda Securities, Erik Selin, FIM Securities, FSB Securities, Interbank, Merita Securities, Opstock and Postipankki.
